lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five semi-parallel horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal region, with the highest luminance concentrated in the mid-flank nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a structured grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the most dorsal ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with a high-luminance superior edge and a distinct shadow-defined inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of faint, high-luminance blobs within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a cluster of approximately six commensal fish (Echeneidae) positioned ventrally and posterior to the pectoral fin's trailing edge.
